journal_lines: §cThe silence changed. §oNot quieter — different. Left quickly. Something did not come back with me.
§cSomething in the deep passage. §oThe air pressure shifted. Left one thing behind. Did not go back for it.
§cDeep tunnel, zone two. §oThe dark had a quality it does not usually have. Came back missing one thing. Do not know when it went.
§cHeard my own breathing returned from the rock. §oThe rock said something different than I had said. Left immediately.
§cA passage that had not been there before. Closed while I was looking at it. §oWalked out. Did not run. Almost ran.
§cThe bag was lighter on the way out than it should have been. §oNoticed at the entrance. Did not go back to check.
§cSomething in the dark that wanted one of the things I was carrying. §oI did not stay to negotiate. It took what it wanted.
§cCame back with less than I left with. §oCannot say exactly what. The gap is there. Something filled it before I got home.
